reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Bigger bench comes from two things: a steady progression on the lift itself and enough total work to recover from. Most lifters do best with 2 to 3 bench sessions a week, mostly sets of 3 to 6 at a load that leaves 1 to 3 reps in reserve, and they add a little weight or a rep whenever the last set goes well. Accessories like triceps work and upper back rows help the lockout and keep the shoulders healthy. If you want a full program built around your bench, tell me your days per week, how long you can train, and what gear you have, and I'll set it up for you."}
